title: Preventing Cross-Function Reentrancy Attacks in Ethereum Smart Contracts
cleaned_summary: Developer friction analysis: High-severity reentrancy vulnerability detected in ETH token withdrawal routines. External call state changes were executed prior to state update variable assignment, allowing attacker contracts to recurse back into state logic.
